notes.text: This page has no displayed publication or revision date. Its reference to six objects returned to Sri Lanka by the end of 2023 is a dated event reported by the page, not a publication date; the page was reviewed on 3 October 2026. It describes Dutch State ownership, ministerial decision-making and Rijksmuseum provenance research, and reports the completed return of six objects to Sri Lanka. The requested short URL resolves to the colonial-collections overview; this more specific page is at the nested reference recorded here.
